rows.grounds: compound describing agents or means constituted by worldly bondage

items.question: What truth must be known to overcome bonds constituted by worldly existence?
premises: A specific truth is presented as an object of knowledge.
The goddess is directly addressed as the recipient of this instruction.
Worldly existence is characterized as having the nature of bondage.
items.inference: Knowing this truth enables transcendence of the bonds inherent in worldly existence.
uncertainties: The referent of bhava+bandhā+tmakaiḥ is not explicit in this verse alone.
The continuation of the sentence is missing in this tail fragment.
items.plain_english: O goddess, O beloved, having known this truth, [one is freed] by those whose nature is the bondage of existence.
